```julia
# =============================================================================
#  Process Identification and Control - Sapienza, DIAG - Prof. Francesco Liberati
#
#  Service area control: one MPC iteration.
#
#  Everything the problem needs is passed in as an argument: no global variables,
#  so changing a weight in main.jl always has the effect you expect.
#
#  Problem solved at time k, over the prediction window i = 1 ... N
#  (i = 1 corresponds to the relative time i = 0 of the lecture notation):
#
#      min  sum_i [ alpha * p_i^2 + beta * (x_i - x_ref)^2 ] + beta_f * (x_{N+1} - x_ref)^2
#      s.t. p_i = u_i + ppev_i - pres_i                  power balance at the POC
#           x_{i+1} = x_i + (T/3600) * u_i               energy stored in the ESS
#           x_1 = x_k                                    measured state
#           u_min <= u_i <= u_max                        ESS power
#           x_min <= x_i <= x_max                        ESS energy
#           p_min <= p_i <= p_max                        power at the POC
#
#  Note on the first term of the sum: x_1 is fixed to the measured state, so
#  beta*(x_1 - x_ref)^2 is a constant. It does not change the minimizer; it is
#  kept because it is the stage cost l(x_{0|k}, u_{0|k}) of the lecture.
# =============================================================================

using JuMP

"""
    mpc_iteration(k, x_k, ppev, pres, par, optimizer)

Build and solve the MPC problem at time step `k`, starting from the measured
energy `x_k`. `ppev` and `pres` are the whole known profiles; the window reads
the N values starting at k. Returns `(u1, p1, status)`: the first control to
apply, the corresponding power at the point of connection, and the solver status.
"""
function mpc_iteration(k::Int, x_k::Float64,
                       ppev::Vector{Float64}, pres::Vector{Float64},
                       par::NamedTuple, optimizer)

    N = par.N
    h = par.T / 3600.0        # [h] energy gained by 1 kW over one sampling time

    mdl = Model(optimizer)
    set_silent(mdl)

    # --- decision variables, with their simple bounds
    @variable(mdl, par.u_min <= u[1:N]   <= par.u_max)      # P^ESS  [kW]
    @variable(mdl, par.x_min <= x[1:N+1] <= par.x_max)      # energy [kWh]
    @variable(mdl, par.p_min <= p[1:N]   <= par.p_max)      # P^POC  [kW]

    # --- power balance at the point of connection
    @constraint(mdl, balance[i = 1:N], p[i] == u[i] + ppev[k+i-1] - pres[k+i-1])

    # --- dynamics of the storage, and the measured initial state
    @constraint(mdl, dynamics[i = 1:N], x[i+1] == x[i] + h * u[i])
    @constraint(mdl, x[1] == x_k)

    # --- objective
    @objective(mdl, Min,
        sum(par.alpha * p[i]^2 + par.beta * (x[i] - par.x_ref)^2 for i in 1:N) +
        par.beta_f * (x[N+1] - par.x_ref)^2)

    optimize!(mdl)

    # --- never read a solution the solver did not actually find
    status = termination_status(mdl)
    if status != MOI.OPTIMAL && status != MOI.LOCALLY_SOLVED
        error("MPC iteration $k did not solve: $status")
    end

    return value(u[1]), value(p[1]), status
end
```
